title: O'zi yozadigan qalam (Kuru Toga Dive)
caption: ✏️ Bu qalamni hech qachon bosmaysiz Yaponiyaning Uni kompaniyasi Kuru Toga Dive mexanik qalamini chiqargan. Qopqog'ini ochishingiz bilan grifel o'zi chiqadi. Yozayotganda u o'zi uzayadi va har chiziqda biroz aylanib, uchi doim o'tkir qoladi. Grifel qancha chiqishini 5 pog'onada sozlaysiz. 💡 Nega qiziq: batareya ham, elektronika ham yo'q — hammasi mexanika. Qopqoq magnit bilan «chiq» etib yopiladi. 🛒 Uni rasmiy do'koni (AQSh) — $99.99 📦 Toshkentgacha • Tovar — $99.99 • AQShdan yetkazish — ~$9.50 • Toshkent bo'ylab — ~$3 • Jami ≈ 1 324 000 so'm ✅ Olib kira olasizmi? Ha. Batareyasiz oddiy kantselyariya, cheklangan ro'yxatlarda yo'q. Narxi kuryer normasidan (oyiga 200 $) kam — boj yo'q. Pochta orqali norma 100 $: qalam sig'adi, lekin shu oyda boshqa posilka bo'lmasin. Siz shunday qalam bilan yozarmidingiz? 👇 📄 Asos: VM 244-son, 19.04.2025 — lex.uz ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #topilma
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#topilma".
2) Center: a sleek glossy deep-blue premium mechanical pencil lying diagonally with its magnetic cap removed beside it; a fine graphite tip writes a thin elegant line on a sheet of paper, with a few subtle motion arcs showing the lead slowly rotating. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of aqua (#22D3EE); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Bu qalamni hech qachon bosmaysiz"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Bunday narsa borligini bilarmidingiz?"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.

Do'kon AQSh ichiga yetkazadi — ekspeditor manzili kerak. Og'irlik qadoq bilan taxminan 0,2 kg. RASM: ChatGPT'ga do'kon sahifasidagi qalam suratini biriktiring.
